loop: Read AGENTS, latest user instructions, queue and cinema handoff; inspect current ownership before edits.
Choose highest-priority actionable item. Reuse KB sources before targeted research. Reserve one article and explicit worker scopes.
Capture source provenance, inspected passages, competing evidence, perspective and limits. Treat inability to find a source as a gap, not disproof.
Revise only supported content; separate factual claims from interpretations and testimony; keep numbered source notes.
Obtain separate review; repair material issues and rebuild affected outputs; run appropriate KB and preview checks.
Record changes, findings, attempts and next action; release worker scopes. Move on without repeating exhausted searches.
completion_criteria: Every action item has evidence-backed review or a specific unresolved dependency; unresolved is never marked complete.
Every material sensitive/comparative claim in the current drafts is supported, qualified or removed.
Coverage matrix and selection rationale expose omissions and source-access imbalance.
Independent review has no unresolved publication-critical finding; permissions and image adaptations are explicit.
Two consecutive final review passes find no new material factual or framing issue in the eleven-article scope (eight cinema drafts, AIR Cuttack, Odia television and Odia OTT).
Provide a final user review package. Research-ready is not published or human-approved.
stop_rules: Stop substantive work and disable this follow-up once research-ready criteria are met; request the user’s editorial review, do not publish.

After three genuinely different failed approaches to a dependency, record attempts, keep it unresolved and work other items. When only external/human dependencies remain, disable follow-up and report once rather than loop indefinitely.
A newer stop instruction overrides this loop. Never contact people, post socially, buy access or publish without explicit authorization.
